rule: Patio mode 'puntos de salida': if the opponent right after the opener cannot play on the first tile, the opener gets 25 or 30. If the opener's partner also cannot play, the points are cancelled.
quote: si la pareja tampoco puede jugar entonces se anulan los puntos de salida
sourceName: Wikipedia (es), Dominó dominicano

rule: Patio mode: when no other player can play (paso corrido), the player who caused it gets 25 or 30 points.
quote: el jugador que dio ese pase corrido se le suman 25 o 30 puntos
sourceName: Wikipedia (es), Dominó dominicano

rule: Pase de salida: if the next player cannot play on the first tile, the opener's team gets 10 points (games to 200 or 250) or 25 points (games to 500).
quote: his team is awarded 10 or 25 points, this depends on the total
sourceName: DR1.com, '25, 50, Capicua!' (page 2)

rule: The pase de salida is cancelled if the player after that also cannot play. It applies only to the first tile of a hand.

sourceName: DR1.com, '25, 50, Capicua!' (page 2)

rule: Pase corrido: all three other players cannot play. The player who last played gets 25 for his team and plays again.
quote: the player who last played receives 25 points towards his team’s total
sourceName: DR1.com, '25, 50, Capicua!' (page 2)

rule: A player can score several pases corridos in the same hand; there is no limit.
quote: there is no limit to the amount of pases corridos one can accumulate
sourceName: DR1.com, '25, 50, Capicua!' (page 2)

rule: Only the pase de salida and the pase corrido score pass points. Making just the next player pass in mid-hand earns nothing.
quote: the only other time that a player can gain points for skipping other players
sourceName: DR1.com, '25, 50, Capicua!' (page 2)

rule: Santiago tournament (2019): a pass on the opening tile is worth 25 points.

rule: In the Dominican Republic, special plays are normally worth 25: pase de salida (second player passes on the opening tile), pase redondo or corrido (other three pass), and capicúa.

rule: Restating DR1: if all three players cannot play, the player who last played earns 25.

rule: Paso redondo or pase corrido does not include a fully locked hand (tranque).

rule: Terminology: the player who places the first tile is 'mano'. If he makes the opponent on his right pass, his partner becomes 'manito'. No points are mentioned.

rule: Dominican patio mode: when a player makes a pase corrido (none of the other three can play), that player gets 25 or 30 points, depending on the rules.
quote: el jugador que dio ese pase corrido se le suman 25 o 30 puntos

rule: Dominican patio mode, 'puntos de salida': if the next opponent cannot answer the first tile, the opener gets 25 or 30. The bonus is cancelled if the opener's partner also cannot play.

rule: App rule: a full pass gives +25 and an opener pass gives +10. Bonuses cannot win the match; a side must win a hand to cross the target.
